verdict.rationale: Google's docs describe an OpenAI-compatibility path: Gemini models can be reached through the OpenAI Python and TypeScript/JavaScript libraries and REST by updating three lines of code and using a Gemini API key. That lets existing OpenAI-compatible tooling point at the platform. Missing for 10: documentation of the compatibility layer's feature coverage and limitations, independent or hands-on corroboration that the OpenAI-compatible path works, and migration or adapter guidance for non-OpenAI SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible tooling at the platform, or follow a documented migration/adapter path from other providers' SDKs

citations.quote: Gemini modellerine, OpenAI kitaplıkları (Python ve TypeScript/JavaScript) ile REST API kullanılarak erişilebilir. Bunun için üç satır kodu güncellemeniz ve Gemini API anahtarınızı kullanmanız gerekir.
Gemini モデルには、OpenAI ライブラリ（Python と TypeScript / JavaScript）と REST API を使用してアクセスできます。
